summaries.semantic_outcome: Both Wii-enabled profiles initially claim owned HIDAPI then disconnect after Nunchuk attach, including the explicit repeated-application-commit control. Actual-default evdev control remains connected. Trace shows host0x12 within milliseconds after status and immediately resumed DATA, with register replies/ACKs continuing; DATA-pause deadlock is not supported by this run. Pinned SDL HandleStatus resets mode then marks extension changes disconnected to reinitialize; this host path matches debug/status/connection observations. No successful sustained HIDAPI reopen established or exact per-packet host actor asserted. MP activation and explicit deactivation writes/ACK/status sequences captured; no model change, invented cadence or physical acceptance.
